routes.label: Use the right angle at the airport

question: Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is \(8\) miles southwest of downtown St. Paul and \(10\) miles southeast of downtown Minneapolis. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles between downtown St. Paul and downtown Minneapolis?
solution:
Reverse the given directions to view both downtown locations from the airport. Downtown St. Paul is northeast of the airport, and downtown Minneapolis is northwest of it. These directions are each \(45^\circ\) from north on opposite sides, so the angle at the airport is \(90^\circ\).

The two airport distances, \(8\) and \(10\) miles, are therefore the legs of a right triangle. If \(x>0\) is the distance between the downtown locations, the Pythagorean theorem gives
\[
x^2=8^2+10^2=164,\qquad x=\sqrt{164}.
\]
Since \(12^2<164<13^2\), the distance lies between \(12\) and \(13\) miles. Every listed choice is at least \(13\), so the closest is \(\boxed{13}\) miles, choice \(\text{A}\).
